text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, so keep tonight’s waterfront plans close to shore. The sunset setup is excellent, clear skies and a south breeze, with temperatures still near the upper 50s. After dark, that breeze stays up around 12 mph, with gusts near 23, and we’ll settle to around 40 by morning. On the broad lake, south winds of 20 to 25 knots will push waves from 1 to 3 feet toward 2 to 4 feet, so this is not a good night for a small boat.

Monday looks like the better outdoor day, sunny from start to finish with a high right around 62. Winds ease on the lake through the day, but start with a south wind of 15 to 20 knots before dropping below 10. Enjoy the evening view from land, and wait until late Monday for the calmest waterfront plans.
